name: posterior_v5
description: As posterior_v4 (same shards: the populations, the beam tail and the diffuse term are those of prior_v4), with the Gaussian core exp(-q^2/2 sigma_q^2) of the resolution function about the direct and the specular beam, of the cut's width sigma_q, drawn when a curve is used: in core_probability of the cuts, core_relative times the particles at q_min, at most core_peak times their peak at q = 0
